comments.text: The conservation segment of this video gave me chills. As a filmmaker, hearing the story of Dian Fossey and how her 18 years of habituating the gorillas is the sole reason we can look these magnificent creatures in the eyes today [17:11] is incredibly moving. Pairing that history with the joy of the Kwita Izina baby naming ceremony [25:31] shows how a country can literally turn trauma into the most successful ecotourism and conservation model on Earth. 🦍🌿
